name: Exp_HighsLowsSignal
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom HighsLowsSignal indicator, which identifies directional price moves over a configurable number of candles. It opens buy positions on bullish signals and sell positions on bearish signals, with optional position closing on opposite signals. Lot sizing and risk management are handled via the included TradeAlgorithms library.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义HighsLowsSignal指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标通过识别一定数量K线的方向性价格变化来产生信号。在看涨信号时开多仓，在看跌信号时开空仓，并可选择在出现反向信号时平仓。仓位和资金管理通过内置的TradeAlgorithms库实现。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA使用HighsLowsSignal指标检测价格连续N根K线朝同一方向运动的趋势信号，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件：当指标的上行缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号Bar上输出非零非EMPTY_VALUE时开多仓，当下行缓冲区（buffer 0）输出有效值时开空仓。出场条件：支持StopLoss和TakeProfit固定点数出场，同时在出现反向信号时平仓（需开启BuyPosClose/SellPosClose权限），还会遍历历史Bar查找最近的反向信号作为平仓依据。仓位管理：通过MM参数控制每次交易占用资金的比例，支持多种保证金模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损比例等），默认使用固定手数(LOT)模式。资金管理：依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数执行交易，包含最大价格偏离(Deviation)参数来控制滑点。策略还使用IsNewBar机制确保每个Bar只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This EA uses the HighsLowsSignal indicator to detect directional price movement over a configurable number of consecutive candles, representing a classic trend-following approach. Entry conditions: A buy signal is generated when the indicator's upper buffer (buffer 1) outputs a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the specified signal bar; a sell signal is generated when the lower buffer (buffer 0) outputs a valid value. Exit conditions: The EA supports fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit exits in points, and optionally closes positions on opposite signals when BuyPosClose/SellPosClose permissions are enabled. It also scans historical bars to find the most recent opposite signal as an additional closing trigger for position direction determination. Position sizing: The MM parameter controls the share of deposit per trade, supporting multiple margin modes including free margin, balance, loss-proportion-based sizing, and fixed lot mode (default). Money management: Trade execution relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen) which incorporate a maximum price deviation (Deviation) parameter for slippage control. The strategy employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing redundant trade attempts within the same candle.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 每次交易占用的资金比例
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio controlling risk per trade

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算方式（自由保证金/余额/亏损比例/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin/balance/margin w/ floating P&L/balance w/ floating P&L/fixed lot

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大允许价格偏离（滑点）点数
parameters.description_en: Max allowed price deviation (slippage) in points

parameters.name: HowManyCandles
parameters.description: 判断方向性价格变化的K线数量
parameters.description_en: Number of bars to determine directional price change

pros: 使用IsNewBar机制避免同根K线重复交易，减少不必要的交易频率
提供灵活的资金管理模式，支持固定手数和基于保证金比例的多种计算方式
止损止盈参数明确，风险控制有基本保障
买卖开仓和平仓权限可独立控制，策略配置灵活度高
反向信号平仓机制提供了额外的趋势反转保护
pros_en: Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent redundant trades within the same candle, reducing unnecessary trading frequency
Provides flexible money management modes supporting both fixed lot and margin-proportion-based sizing
Explicit StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters provide basic risk control assurance
Buy/sell open and close permissions can be independently controlled, offering high configuration flexibility
Opposite signal closing mechanism provides additional protection against trend reversals
cons: 依赖外部HighsLowsSignal自定义指标，指标文件缺失时EA无法运行
缺少止损止盈为0时的保护逻辑，可能导致无限制亏损
历史Bar遍历查找反向信号的循环没有上限保护，可能影响性能
没有考虑点差和交易成本对策略盈利性的影响
SignalBar=0时的特殊逻辑分支可能导致实时信号不稳定
cons_en: Depends on external HighsLowsSignal custom indicator; EA cannot run if the indicator file is missing
Lacks protection logic when StopLoss/TakeProfit is set to 0, potentially leading to unlimited losses
The loop scanning historical bars for opposite signals has no upper bound protection, potentially impacting performance
Does not account for spread and transaction costs' impact on strategy profitability
The special logic branch when SignalBar=0 may cause unstable real-time signals
improvements: 添加止损止盈为0的防护检查，防止意外无止损交易
为历史Bar遍历循环添加最大迭代次数限制，防止性能问题
增加点差过滤条件，避免在高点差时段开仓
improvements_en: Add validation to prevent trading when StopLoss/TakeProfit is zero, avoiding unintended unprotected positions
Add a maximum iteration limit to the historical bar scanning loop to prevent performance issues
Add a spread filter to avoid opening positions during high-spread periods

risk_points: 止损止盈设为0时无保护，可能导致无限制亏损
依赖外部指标文件，缺失时初始化失败但无用户友好提示
历史Bar遍历无上限，极端情况下可能造成延迟
risk_points_en: No protection when StopLoss/TakeProfit is set to 0, potentially leading to unlimited losses
Depends on external indicator file; initialization failure lacks user-friendly error messaging
No upper bound on historical bar scanning loop, potentially causing delays in extreme cases
